finding.summary: Model mismatch check uses grep on JSON, which is fragile to whitespace, key ordering, or formatting differences. Could produce false positives (blocking valid resumption) or false negatives (allowing model mismatch).
finding.fix: Use jq to parse and compare: if [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/run.json" ]] && [[ "$(jq -r .model "$RUN_DIR/run.json")" != "$MODEL" ]]; then

label: real_issue
label_reason: Commit 02d37e7 in the PR cites finding R45-fee8a9a-014.
